proof_body:
by
  intro K _ m n A h
  have hf : Module.finrank K (Fin m → K) < Module.finrank K (Fin n → K) := by
    simpa only [Module.finrank_fin_fun] using h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (LinearMap.ker_ne_bot_of_finrank_lt (f := A.mulVecLin) hf)
  exact ⟨x, hx0, hx⟩
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (m n : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) K), m < n → ∃ x : Fin n → K, x ≠ 0 ∧ A.mulVec x = 0
